bearerAuth.description: Bearer token matching a configured FerroGate API key. Read endpoints require admin.read and write endpoints require admin.write when API keys are configured.

value.message: provider is not allowed for this key

disableCacheForAgent.summary: Disable exact-match cache for an agent workflow.

sourceFile.summary: Reload from the process source file.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request payload or candidate config.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer token when API keys are configured.

Forbidden.description: Bearer token lacks the required scope or is disallowed by tenant/provider/model constraints.

NotFound.description: Requested API key or policy was not found.

Conflict.description: Runtime rejected the candidate process-local reload.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the endpoint limit.

state_backend.description: Cluster control-plane state backend. local is process-local; file uses a shared JSON file for lightweight multi-node API key and policy propagation.

counter_backend.description: Cluster counter backend. local is process-local; redis uses shared atomic counters for cluster-safe request limits and token-budget reservation/settlement.

cluster_observations.description: Cluster-wide provider observations when a shared aggregation backend is configured. Null means this node only has local observations.

health_rank.description: Lower ranks are preferred by latency-aware and balanced routing.

key_source.description: Redacted source classification; secret values are never returned.

cache_enabled.description: Optional per-key override for exact-match AI response caching. Null inherits the global/model cache policy.

key.description: Plain secret for local development only. Prefer key_env or key_hash.

cache_enabled.description: Optional per-key override for exact-match AI response caching.
Optional request-time override for exact-match AI response caching within the global cache policy.

source.description: Use source=file to read the config file that started the current process.
